---
description: Write one line per table and report, so you can choose what to slice.
title: ichnos summary
---

`ichnos summary` writes one line per table and one per report, so you can choose what to slice.
`--owner` keeps the tables of one owner and the reports that read one, and `--keyword` keeps the tables and reports whose names, column names or observed values contain it, ignoring case.

## Usage

```{python}
#| label: help
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("summary", "--help")
```

## Example

```{python}
#| label: example
#| echo: false
from _scripts.example import ichnos

ichnos("summary", "queries", "--keyword", "customer")
```
